title.ja: 年金の早期引き出しを促す『ペンション解放』詐欺

short_desc.ja: 55歳未満での年金引き出しを約束し、資金を奪取
short_desc.en: Promises pension access before 55 to seize funds.

cultural_lever.ja: 急な資金需要と年金制度の複雑さに対する不安
cultural_lever.en: Urgent cash needs; confusion over pension rules

scenario.ja: 1) 55歳未満への引き出し提案 2) 『ペンション解放』『ペンションローン』の名目 3) 海外スキームへ資金移転 4) 高額手数料と55%の税負担
scenario.en: 1) Offer early withdrawal 2) 'pension liberation' or 'pension loan' 3) Move pot to overseas scheme 4) 30% fee + 55% tax

ja: 55歳未満でも引き出せるという説明
海外に設定されたスキーム
手数料として約半額が差し引かれる
en: Claims you can access pension before 55

ja: 55歳前の年金引き出しはほぼ詐欺と判断
FCA Firm Checker で業者確認
en: Treat pre-55 access as a scam
Check firms on FCA Firm Checker

legal_notes.ja: 55歳未満の引き出しには最大55%の課税。FCA へ報告
legal_notes.en: Early withdrawal attracts up to 55% tax; report to FCA

references.label: FCA: Pension scams - how early pension release scams work
references.quote: Offers to access your pension early may be called 'pension liberation' or a 'pension loan', as the scammers often claim you can borrow money from your pension fund. If you take up the offer, your pension funds will be transferred into a scheme set up by the scam, which will often be based abroad.

verification.note: FCA が『pension liberation』『pension loan』の名称と、海外スキームへの資金移転を具体的に記述。接触経路（offer to access early）と結果（transferred into a scheme ... based abroad）に対応。手数料30%+税55%の資金損失のため risk_score=5
